title: F171 the bill checker: the overview
caption: Eight children, in order: photos reach a tool, the bills pack reads and checks, the letter, the identity and its evals, the account and subscription, the phone app, the stores, and the monthly report.

cards.title: F171 The bill checker
cards.text: A phone app that reads a municipal account, checks every line against the right tariff, and drafts the dispute.

cards.title: F171.1 Photos reach a tool
cards.text: The engine keeps an upload and lets a tool have the model read it into a record.

cards.title: F171.2 Read and check
cards.text: The bills pack: the bill record, dated tariffs as data, the sums in C#.

cards.title: F171.3 The letter
cards.text: A s102(2) dispute from the facts found, for the resident to send.

cards.title: F171.4 Identity and evals
cards.text: The bill checker's voice and guard rails, measured on real bills.

cards.title: F171.5 Account and subscription
cards.text: Bills kept per account, deletion, the free cap and store receipts checked.

cards.title: F171.6 The phone app
cards.text: Camera, PDF, chat and paywall; Android, then iPhone.

cards.title: F171.7 To the stores
cards.text: Listings, privacy, testing and approval for South Africa.

cards.title: F171.8 The monthly report
cards.text: A household report each month from the readings the account keeps.
